description: Device certificates (A.1 device_cert, domain and ML-DSA context pal3-devcert-v1), identity-signed revocation statements (pal3-revocation-v1) and the receiver rules of 11.3 items 3, 4 and 6.

certificates.name: delegatedDeviceCertificate
certificates.description: Delegated certificate (flags 0x00): the identity signs the device keys and a 16-byte device_id

certificates.name: selfCertifiedCertificate
certificates.description: Self-certified certificate (flags 0x01): no device key tags, the identity keys are the device keys

certificates.name: optionalExtensionIsIgnored
certificates.description: A comprehension-optional extension tag (0xC001) is covered by the signature and ignored by a verifier that does not know it

certificatesRejected.name: expiredCertificate
certificatesRejected.description: now is at expires_at_ms: a certificate is valid only before it

certificatesRejected.name: issuedMoreThanFiveMinutesAhead
certificatesRejected.description: issued_at_ms is 6 minutes after the verifier clock

certificatesRejected.name: deviceKeySignsItsOwnCertificate
certificatesRejected.description: A malicious device signs a certificate for itself with its device keys: the signature does not verify under the identity keys

certificatesRejected.name: deviceIdChangedAfterSigning
certificatesRejected.description: The device_id is replaced after signing

certificatesRejected.name: deviceKeysSwappedAfterSigning
certificatesRejected.description: The device keys are replaced by another device after signing

certificatesRejected.name: unknownFlags
certificatesRejected.description: flags 0x02 is neither delegated nor self-certified

certificatesRejected.name: selfCertifiedWithDeviceKeys
certificatesRejected.description: A self-certified certificate that also carries device key tags

certificatesRejected.name: unknownCriticalExtension
certificatesRejected.description: A critical extension tag (0x8001) the verifier does not know: the certificate is refused

receiverSequence.name: noStatementYet_delegatedAccepted
receiverSequence.description: No statement is held: both certificate forms are accepted

receiverSequence.name: noStatementYet_selfCertifiedAccepted
receiverSequence.description: No statement is held: the self-certified form is accepted

receiverSequence.name: firstStatementIsApplied
receiverSequence.description: Version 1 with an empty set is the first statement

receiverSequence.name: afterAnyStatement_selfCertifiedRefused
receiverSequence.description: Once any statement is held the identity self-certified certificates are refused: their device_id cannot be revoked

receiverSequence.name: emptySet_delegatedAccepted
receiverSequence.description: A delegated certificate whose device_id is not in the set

receiverSequence.name: revokedDeviceRefused
receiverSequence.description: Device A is in the revoked set

receiverSequence.name: rollbackToOlderVersionIsNotApplied
receiverSequence.description: A correctly signed older statement (version 1, stored is 2) must not roll the revocation back

receiverSequence.name: sameVersionIsNotApplied
receiverSequence.description: The same version as the stored one (2, with an empty set) is not applied

receiverSequence.name: sameVersionOtherSetIsNotApplied
receiverSequence.description: Version 3 again with another set (an attempt to change the set at the same version) is not applied

receiverSequence.name: deviceBRevokedAfterVersion3
receiverSequence.description: Device B is revoked by version 3 and stays revoked

receiverSequence.name: statementForAnotherIdentityIsRefused
receiverSequence.description: A valid statement whose issuer is not the identity the receiver trusts for the sender

receiverSequence.name: statementSignedByADeviceIsRefused
receiverSequence.description: A malicious device signs a statement with its device keys

receiverSequence.name: malformedDeviceIdListIsRefused
receiverSequence.description: revoked_device_ids of 17 bytes is not a multiple of 16

operations.name: pushFirstStatement
operations.description: The identity pushes its first statement (version 2)

operations.name: pushOlderVersionIsNotApplied
operations.description: Version 2 is stored; version 1 answers applied = false and the stored version

operations.name: pushSameVersionIsNotApplied
operations.description: The stored version again with another set is not applied

operations.name: pushNewerVersionIsApplied
operations.description: Version 3 over a stored 2

operations.name: pushStatementOfAnotherIdentity
operations.description: The caller is the owner but the statement names another identity

operations.name: pushByAnotherIdentityOfOwnersStatement
operations.description: The caller is another identity and pushes a statement of the owner: the issuer is not the identity of the session

operations.name: pushWhenTrustedIdentityDiffersFromTheSession
operations.description: The identity trusted for the sender is not the identity of the session certificate

operations.name: pushByANonPal
operations.description: Pals only

operations.name: pushStatementSignedByADevice
operations.description: A statement signed by a device key does not verify

operations.name: pushMalformedDeviceIdList
operations.description: revoked_device_ids of 17 bytes

operations.name: pushStatementIsNotText
operations.description: statement must be a base64 text

operations.name: pushWithoutStatement
operations.description: An empty body

operations.name: pushEmptyText
operations.description: An empty text

operations.name: pushTextOfExactlySixtyFourKiB
operations.description: A text of 65536 characters passes the size check (and is no statement)

operations.name: pushTextAboveSixtyFourKiB
operations.description: A text of 65537 characters is refused by size

operations.name: pushNewIdentityWhenTheTableIsFull
operations.description: The table holds one identity (the other one) and is full: a new identity answers E_BUSY and nothing is evicted

operations.name: pushKnownIdentityWhenTheTableIsFull
operations.description: A newer statement of an identity already in a full table is applied

operations.name: pushWithoutAStore
operations.description: A node that keeps no statements fails closed

operations.name: getOwnStatement
operations.description: An empty body returns the responder's own statement

operations.name: getOwnStatementWhenNone
operations.description: No own statement: null

operations.name: getStatementOfAStoredIdentity
operations.description: identity is the 64 lowercase hex characters of an Ed25519 key

operations.name: getStatementOfAnUnknownIdentity
operations.description: No statement held for that identity: null

operations.name: getWithUpperCaseIdentity
operations.description: Upper-case hexadecimal is not the specified form

operations.name: getWithShortIdentity
operations.description: An identity of 62 hexadecimal characters

operations.name: getWithIdentityThatIsNotText
operations.description: identity of the wrong type

operations.name: getByANonPal
operations.description: Pals only

operations.name: getWithoutAStore
operations.description: A node that keeps no statements fails closed

handshakeRevocationVersion.name: bothZero
handshakeRevocationVersion.description: Nothing is known on either side

handshakeRevocationVersion.name: responderEqualsWhatInitiatorHolds
handshakeRevocationVersion.description: The responder advertises 5 and the initiator holds 5

handshakeRevocationVersion.name: responderAboveWhatInitiatorHolds
handshakeRevocationVersion.description: The responder advertises 6 and the initiator holds 5

handshakeRevocationVersion.name: responderBelowWhatInitiatorHolds
handshakeRevocationVersion.description: The responder advertises 4 and the initiator holds 5: the initiator refuses before it sends FINISH

handshakeRevocationVersion.name: responderAdvertisesNothingButInitiatorHoldsOne
handshakeRevocationVersion.description: The responder advertises 0 and the initiator holds 1

handshakeRevocationVersion.name: initiatorEqualsWhatResponderHolds
handshakeRevocationVersion.description: The initiator advertises 7 and the responder holds 7

handshakeRevocationVersion.name: initiatorBelowWhatResponderHolds
handshakeRevocationVersion.description: The initiator advertises 6 and the responder holds 7: the responder refuses before READY

handshakeRevocationVersion.name: initiatorAdvertisesNothingButResponderHoldsOne
handshakeRevocationVersion.description: The initiator advertises 0 and the responder holds 1
